source.title: A Fine Mess
source.description:
<Kernobee groans.> Wha.. What happened?

The last thing I remember is being captured by a group of dark iron dwarves, beaten to within an inch of my life and then thrown in here with these filthy troggs.

Get me out of here, <name>!

Here's the plan: Lead me to the exit; if we make it out alive, you go to Booty Bay and let Scooty know that I went to Ratchet to warn Tinkerwiz of the dark iron's involvement in the making of that super rig.

Let's get going!
source.objective: Escort Kernobee to the Clockwerk Run exit and then report to Scooty in Booty Bay.
source.completion: I suppose you should be rewarded for bringing Kernobee back to us in one piece, <name>. If you go back to Gnomeregan, these might give you the edge you'll need in defeating that good-for-nothing backstabber, Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
